recap: At midnight, Tokyo abruptly loses its color and freezes into a silent monochrome simulation. High schooler Ren and rogue hacker Mira discover they are the only people still moving amidst the standstill. When faceless Cleaners spawn to purge the anomaly, the pair must run for their lives.
bible: Every midnight, Tokyo freezes into an eerie monochrome void. Cynical student Ren and fiery underground hacker Mira discover they are the only two people awake, hunted by faceless Cleaners. Armed with a cracked pocket terminal predicting future deletions, they must solve why reality resets in seven days and who erased their shared pasts. As familiar landmarks vanish permanently, each episode uncovers deadly simulation anomalies, forcing them to race against the ultimate system wipe. Who engineered the loop?
look: Ren: messy jet-black hair, sharp amber eyes, oversized navy blazer over a dark gray hoodie, silver ear cuff. Mira: chin-length silver bob with neon-pink underdye, electric violet eyes, cropped black techwear jacket, fingerless gloves, high-waisted cargo pants.
style: anime style, cinematic lighting, vibrant colors, highly detailed, vertical poster composition
